content: Postgres data must be mounted to a Docker named volume (e.g. 'db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data') declared in the compose 'volumes:' top-level key; 'docker compose down' (without -v) preserves named volumes across recreation, only 'docker compose down -v' or 'docker volume rm' destroys them — this distinction is the basis for a canary persistence test (write row, down, up, assert row still present).
